content.body: Hmm for https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/12782 I guess we could reduce the number of elements (and response size) by using Custom Highlight for syntax highlighting. Don't know if it would make much difference though

I wrote [a bit](https://blog.farre.se/posts/2026/08/17/tracing-web-specs/) about tracing algorithms through web specs, using jjaschke's [`webspec-index`](https://github.com/jjaschke/webspec-index) and a [Firefox extension](https://addons.mozilla.org/firefox/addon/webspec-tracer/) I made.
